title: 100 Sarvam AI healthcare workflow proposals for Sahara
provider: Sarvam AI; sponsor identity separately confirmed by root from email
evidenceInterpretation: H001-H100 are original proposals inferred from documented component capabilities and primary healthcare workflow references. They are not 100 shipped products, clinically validated capabilities, a partnership or features already in Sahara. Application/backend work is required beyond Sarvam APIs.
researchScope: Read-only public-source research. No API call, patient upload, account/billing change, app implementation, mail or clinical deployment made.
capabilityCautions: Current STT docs recommend Saaras v4 and the opened TTS guide documents Bulbul v4 Flash. Some quickstart/landing-page prose retains older versions. Pin and test the supported model/endpoint at implementation.

Language coverage differs by API. Opened STT and formal translation docs list 22 Indian languages plus English, while Bulbul v4 Flash lists 11 codes. Translation availability does not imply TTS availability.

Transcription is not clinical interpretation. HealthPlix uses a separate proprietary clinical layer after Sarvam STT. Source-linked structured output still requires clinical review; JSON shape does not establish truth.

Check negation, speaker attribution, numbers, units, medicine brands and uncertainty. Start with clinician-authored synthetic gold examples. Test representative patient data only after appropriate authorization and governance.

US educational sources and international tools provide workflow context, not Indian legal/clinical instructions. Local clinical approval, data-processing arrangements, consent and regulation remain prerequisites.
Ariadne and other tools may require license/adaptation permission. This catalog references their purpose without reproducing commercial-ready clinical scripts.
Credits do not authorize patient-data processing. Root handles provider terms, credit activation, retention, residency, costs and permitted healthcare scope.
No proposal performs autonomous diagnosis, prognosis, triage, prescribing, treatment selection or dosing. Existing emergency contact access must work without a model.

evidenceTypeLegend.capability: Official provider API documentation; modality evidence, not medical validation.
evidenceTypeLegend.workflowContext: Primary healthcare organization resource; supports the care job, not efficacy of proposed AI.
evidenceTypeLegend.existingDeployment: Named provider/customer case study; self-reported, not an independent trial.
evidenceTypeLegend.researchCaution: Original research preprint; limitations evidence, not certification of current models.

prioritySaharaOpportunities.why: Voice navigation removes typing without changing the familiar UI; start with low-consequence screen-opening commands.
Conversational access to verified centre and MapLibre data gives a practical next step without inventing medical advice.
A short confirmed voice diary helps a tired patient report experience; a staffed clinician workflow owns interpretation.
Clinician-led GOCD drafting with source spans is Sahara-specific; clinical decisions stay with the clinician and patient.
A saved teach-back response lets a nurse check understanding rather than assume translation equals comprehension.
Approved-plan read-aloud improves access; verify numbers and medication pronunciation before patient use.
Practical caregiver handover makes daily coordination easier without autonomous clinical decisions.
Synthetic clinical-language evaluation is a prerequisite for expansion beyond low-consequence tasks.

documentedHealthcareExamples.name: HealthPlix HALO
documentedHealthcareExamples.whatOtherSystemDoes: HealthPlix proprietary models structure clinical content; doctors review the record.
documentedHealthcareExamples.generativeUse: Sarvam speech recognition is one component; clinical interpretation/structuring belongs to a separate HealthPlix layer.
documentedHealthcareExamples.limitation: Vendor/customer report, not independent validation. Reported prescription accuracy must not be attributed to standalone Sarvam or Sahara.

documentedHealthcareExamples.name: National Health Authority Ayushman awareness outreach
documentedHealthcareExamples.whatSarvamDoes: Multilingual telephone voice agents explain a health scheme and capture interest.
documentedHealthcareExamples.whatOtherSystemDoes: NHA defines campaign messages and manages programme enrollment.
documentedHealthcareExamples.generativeUse: Conversational information exchange over voice, not diagnosis.
documentedHealthcareExamples.limitation: Administrative outreach case study; enrollment change is correlational and does not prove clinical outcomes or Sahara funding.

sourceList.title: Speech-to-Text APIs
sourceList.claim: Saaras supports transcription modes, code mixing, timestamps and batch/streaming paths. Modality availability does not establish clinical accuracy.

sourceList.title: Bulbul v4 Flash best practices
sourceList.claim: Indian-language speech synthesis, pacing and streaming are available; medical pronunciation and numbers still require checking.

sourceList.title: Chat Completion API
sourceList.claim: Constrained JSON and tool calling are supported. Application code must still validate meaning and permissions.

sourceList.title: Sarvam Translate
sourceList.claim: Formal translation supports English and 22 scheduled Indian languages; this is not certified medical interpreting.

sourceList.title: Document Intelligence Overview
sourceList.claim: OCR and schema-based extraction are available. Clinical fields require checking against original documents.

sourceList.title: Document Translation API Overview
sourceList.claim: Document translation is an API workflow; layout and clinical meaning need review before patient use.

sourceList.title: Developer Quickstart
sourceList.claim: Speech, translation, chat and document APIs are offered. Credits, app integration and permission to process health data are separate.

sourceList.title: WHO Palliative care
sourceList.claim: Palliative care addresses physical, psychosocial, spiritual and practical needs through multidisciplinary, community and home services.

sourceList.title: NCI Palliative Care in Cancer
sourceList.claim: Cancer palliative care includes caregiver support, care-team communication and goals-of-care discussions under licensed providers.

sourceList.title: NCI Informal Caregivers in Cancer
sourceList.claim: Caregivers have coordination, information, emotional, social and financial needs. This is educational material, not a formal clinical guideline.

sourceList.title: Ariadne Labs Serious Illness Conversation Guide
sourceList.claim: The clinician tool addresses values, goals, information preferences and documentation. Adaptation requires license review and local approval.

sourceList.title: AHRQ Tool: Teach-Back
sourceList.claim: Teach-back asks people to explain instructions in their own words so the clinician can check clarity and understanding.

sourceList.title: WHO Medication safety in transitions of care
sourceList.claim: Safe transitions need structured medication processes, reliable information, patient/family partnership and qualified staff.

sourceList.title: NCI Questions to Ask Your Doctor about Advanced Cancer
sourceList.claim: This supports preparing questions for an oncology team, not AI prognosis or treatment selection.

sourceList.title: NCI Plans and Decisions for End-of-Life Care as a Cancer Caregiver
sourceList.claim: Care-team discussions help communicate patient choices and practical needs. US legal references are not Indian legal instructions.

sourceList.title: AHRQ Re-Engineered Discharge Toolkit: Tool3 continued
sourceList.claim: Discharge communication covers follow-up visits, transport, medicines, instructions and checking understanding.

sourceList.title: WHO Ethics and governance of AI for health: large multi-modal models
sourceList.claim: Broad generative-AI capabilities do not prove safe or effective clinical use; governance and validation are needed.

sourceList.title: SamaVaani: Auditing and Debiasing Multilingual Clinical ASR for Indian Languages
sourceList.claim: Original-research preprint reports language and demographic variation across clinical ASR systems including Sarvam; not validation of current v4 or palliative use.

sourceList.title: DGHS National Programme for Palliative Care
sourceList.claim: Indian programme context includes district integration, multidisciplinary care and community resources; it does not promise Sahara procurement or funding.

sourceList.title: Sarvam customer story: HealthPlix HALO
sourceList.claim: Sarvam transcribes; HealthPlix's separate proprietary clinical layer structures records for doctor review. This is vendor/customer reporting, not independent validation.

sourceList.title: Sarvam customer story: National Health Authority
sourceList.claim: Multilingual telephone outreach about a health scheme is an administrative/public-health application, not diagnosis or patient treatment.

useCases.title: Speak to navigate Sahara
useCases.workflow: Spoken screen request -> recognize an allowed intent -> open matching screen and read its label
useCases.requiredHumanReview: User confirms writes and sharing.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Navigation only; no urgent-care decision inferred from intent.

useCases.title: Hear the signed care plan
useCases.workflow: Clinician-approved plan -> synthesize unchanged text -> replay the latest signed instructions
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician approves source; bilingual reviewer checks clinical numbers and pronunciation.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No invented instruction or dose change; retain readable source and version.

useCases.title: Consent-based consultation captions
useCases.user: Patient with hearing difficulty and clinician
useCases.workflow: Consented encounter audio -> transcribe with uncertain spans -> visible editable captions
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician and patient resolve important errors during the encounter.
useCases.implementationBoundary: A communication aid, not a certified interpreter or final clinical record.

useCases.title: Interpreter-supported language relay
useCases.workflow: Utterance -> transcribe and translate side by side -> interpreter verifies before action
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Qualified interpreter or bilingual clinician verifies consequential meaning.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Never replace human verification for consent, prognosis or emergency communication.

useCases.title: Preserve names and preferred scripts
useCases.workflow: Spoken name and preferred script -> propose spelling -> patient-confirmed profile name
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient or registrar verifies spelling and identity.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automatic patient matching or merging by similar names.

useCases.title: Plain-language discharge draft
useCases.workflow: Signed discharge instructions -> draft shorter explanation retaining facts -> approved patient handout
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Discharge clinician checks medicines, warnings, times and omissions.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not compress away warnings; link the signed original.

useCases.title: Record teach-back for the nurse
useCases.workflow: Patient explains agreed plan aloud -> exact transcript beside plan -> nurse checks understanding
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Nurse judges understanding and reteaches where needed.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automated pass/fail score or authorization for a clinical task.

useCases.title: Turn a voice concern into a message
useCases.workflow: Spoken care-team question -> concise faithful message draft -> user previews and sends
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Sender confirms wording and recipient; clinician answers.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not answer the clinical question while drafting it.

useCases.title: Listen to a verified document
useCases.user: Patient with low vision or fatigue
useCases.workflow: Selected document and verified text -> read section by section -> accessible playback with page reference
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinical fields are checked against the image before playback.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Uncertain medicine text must stop rather than be guessed aloud.

useCases.title: Explain sharing choices accessibly
useCases.workflow: Actual sharing screen -> approved plain-language explanation/audio -> patient selects record access
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Privacy lead approves explanations; patient chooses and may revise.
useCases.implementationBoundary: AI does not consent for the person or establish caregiver legal authority.

useCases.title: Dictate a clinician visit note
useCases.workflow: Clinician dictation -> exact transcript and template placement -> unsigned editable note
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician verifies and signs.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No inferred diagnosis, normal findings or treatment plan.

useCases.title: Capture a home nurse's observations
useCases.workflow: After-visit dictation -> organize stated observations and completed tasks -> reviewed visit entry
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Nurse checks facts and signs.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not infer that an omitted examination was normal or a planned task happened.

useCases.title: Make an MDT action record
useCases.workflow: Consented meeting audio -> attributed transcript and explicit decisions -> owners, deadlines and meeting draft
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Meeting chair checks decisions, speakers and assignments.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Speaker labels need confirmation; generate no new clinical consensus.

useCases.title: Prepare a transition handover
useCases.workflow: Signed notes plus approved template -> source-linked relevant facts -> handover draft
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Responsible clinician verifies and signs before transfer.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automatic chart export or disclosure without record-level authorization.

useCases.title: Document a nurse callback
useCases.workflow: Consented callback recording -> concerns, advice actually given and next steps -> approved call note
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Nurse checks against audio before saving.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Never fill missing advice or invent a completed referral.

useCases.title: Assemble a referral packet
useCases.workflow: Approved referral reason and selected documents -> organize dated references -> approved referral bundle
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Referrer verifies identity, reason and minimum necessary contents.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automatic eligibility decision or document sharing.

useCases.title: Build a patient-stated history timeline
useCases.workflow: Confirmed patient statements and dated records -> chronological organization -> provenance-linked timeline
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician resolves conflicting accounts and dates.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Separate reported and observed findings; infer no disease progression.

useCases.title: Find the right historical record
useCases.workflow: Question about a prior signed record -> search access-controlled OCR/metadata -> page and matching extract
useCases.requiredHumanReview: User opens original before using the clinical fact.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No unsupported answer or cross-patient record merge.

useCases.title: Flag documentation gaps for completion
useCases.workflow: Unsigned draft plus local field schema -> locate blanks or unsupported fields -> completion checklist
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Author decides missing, not applicable or intentionally absent.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Flag absence only; never fabricate values or infer consent.

useCases.title: Link a correction to original words
useCases.workflow: Correction and audio timestamp -> align edited field to source -> auditable corrected note
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician approves correction and amendment history.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No silent rewriting of the clinical record.

useCases.title: Prepare what matters before a visit
useCases.workflow: Optional spoken reflections -> organize patient's own words -> private clinician-discussion agenda
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient approves reflection; clinician interprets in visit.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No prognosis, medical decision or advance directive from reflections.

useCases.title: Draft the clinician-led GOCD record
useCases.workflow: Consented goals-of-care discussion -> transcript and evidence-linked sections -> unsigned goals-of-care draft
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician reviews with patient and signs.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not infer preferences, code status or decisions from silence or vague remarks.

useCases.title: Record information preferences
useCases.workflow: Patient states what they want to know and who may hear -> structured draft -> confirmed communication card
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient and clinician confirm current preference.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Does not establish capacity or substitute decision-maker authority.

useCases.title: Keep hopes and worries in the patient's words
useCases.workflow: Patient-selected reflection -> faithful transcript and optional categories -> approved quotes beside notes
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient approves quotes to be shared.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No sentiment score, psychiatric label or survival prediction.

useCases.title: Prepare participation for a family meeting
useCases.workflow: Named people, language needs and disclosure scope -> meeting checklist -> coordinator arranges participation
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms participation/disclosure; coordinator verifies contacts.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Attendance gives no automatic decision authority or whole-record access.

useCases.title: Show changes in confirmed care goals
useCases.workflow: Dated signed goal records -> highlight explicit text differences -> review of current wishes
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician and patient confirm what still applies.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automatic replacement of goals or interpretation of contradictions.

useCases.title: Create a patient-approved GOCD recap
useCases.workflow: Signed note -> plain-language translated draft -> reviewed take-home summary
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician and bilingual reviewer verify; patient confirms meaning.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No binding directive or medical order; link signed original.

useCases.title: Build an agenda for a difficult family discussion
useCases.workflow: Approved concerns and open questions -> organize neutral topics -> human-led meeting agenda
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Social worker checks neutrality and patient priorities.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No autonomous mediation or pressure toward a care option.

useCases.title: List unresolved care questions without deciding them
useCases.workflow: Meeting transcript -> identify explicit unanswered/disputed points -> next-discussion question list
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Facilitator checks attribution and omissions.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No AI finding of best-interest treatment, capacity or who is right.

useCases.title: Track agreed GOCD follow-up actions
useCases.workflow: Signed discussion's explicit actions -> convert approved actions into assigned tasks -> reminders and completion record
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician approves clinical tasks; person confirms completion.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No new decision or completed-care claim from a reminder or checkbox.

useCases.title: Speak a daily symptom diary
useCases.workflow: Today's experience in patient's words -> transcribe report fields -> confirm and save for team review
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms entry; clinician interprets clinical meaning.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No diagnosis, urgency score or dosing advice; immediate help access stays separate.

useCases.title: Capture a clinician-selected symptom questionnaire
useCases.workflow: Approved instrument delivered aloud -> capture answers verbatim -> nurse receives responses
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician selects instrument and interprets; patient confirms recognized answers.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Use licensed locally validated wording; scoring only deterministic and separately approved.

useCases.title: Summarize changes the patient reported
useCases.workflow: Confirmed dated diary entries -> compare explicit values/quotes -> source-linked change summary
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Nurse checks sources and decides action.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No progression inference, predicted deterioration or autonomous clinical prioritization.

useCases.title: Turn an unstructured worry into a callback request
useCases.workflow: Spoken concern and contact preference -> capture request -> receipt in staffed team's queue
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Nurse reads concern and decides urgency using local protocol.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not promise continuous monitoring; emergency route cannot depend on model interpretation.

useCases.title: Record sleep and meaningful activity
useCases.workflow: Patient describes rest and activities -> organize stated account -> functional diary
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; clinician reviews when clinically used.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No insomnia diagnosis, performance-status estimate or exercise recommendation.

useCases.title: Log observations about food and fluids
useCases.workflow: Observed intake and uncertainty -> preserve exact quantities -> confirmed observation log
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Caregiver confirms; nurse assesses need for action.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No nutritional prescription, fluid target or judgement that intake is safe.

useCases.title: Prepare a pain conversation
useCases.workflow: Words about discomfort and worries -> questions plus attributed timeline -> appointment discussion aid
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; clinician assesses pain and treatment.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No diagnosis, opioid recommendation or dose adjustment.

useCases.title: Retrieve an approved home-care instruction
useCases.workflow: Question plus current signed nursing plan -> retrieve approved passage -> source and exact read-aloud
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Nurse approves library and patient-specific applicability.
useCases.implementationBoundary: If no approved match, offer staff contact instead of generating procedural steps.

useCases.title: Read back nurse-dictated measurements
useCases.workflow: Nurse dictates an already measured value, unit and time -> transcribe into separate fields -> read back for correction before saving
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Nurse verifies the exact value, unit, time and patient identity against the measurement before saving.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not infer a missing unit, calculate a new measurement, interpret a reading or recommend a response. Keep the original dictation available; this does not connect a medical device.

useCases.title: Replay the clinician's emergency contact plan
useCases.workflow: Approved contact plan -> exact accessible display/audio -> one-tap verified service call
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Care team verifies contacts and plan version.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No AI triage, reassurance or delay; verified call access works without generation.

useCases.title: Transcribe a prescription into a review screen
useCases.workflow: Prescription image -> extract written fields with source links -> unconfirmed medicine draft
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist or prescriber verifies every field against original.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No guessed handwriting, new prescription or reminder before professional approval.

useCases.title: Prepare medication reconciliation discrepancies
useCases.workflow: Two source lists -> highlight literal differences and provenance -> reconciliation worksheet
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist or clinician decides current list.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Never automatically start, stop, merge or deduplicate medicines by fuzzy matching.

useCases.title: Record a patient's medicine-taking statement
useCases.workflow: Spoken account of what was taken and when -> read back uncertainties -> confirmed self-report log
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Reporter confirms; pharmacist reviews discrepancies.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No catch-up-dose advice, timing change or adherence inference from app opens.

useCases.title: Draft a refill request
useCases.workflow: Verified medicine plus request -> unchanged enquiry draft -> patient approves pharmacy message
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist checks validity and approves dispensing.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automatic controlled-drug order, renewal or availability promise.

useCases.title: Collect questions for a pharmacist
useCases.workflow: Spoken uncertainty and approved medicine list -> preserve exact question -> pharmacist message draft
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; pharmacist answers.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No generated interaction, substitution, side-effect or dosing advice.

useCases.title: Hear the approved medication schedule
useCases.workflow: Professionally verified schedule -> exact spoken labels -> replayable schedule
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist checks pronunciation, numbers and source version.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No schedule from unverified OCR; keep units and warnings.

useCases.title: Translate test preparation instructions
useCases.workflow: Lab-approved preparation sheet -> translated draft -> reviewed pre-test instructions
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Lab team and qualified bilingual reviewer check clinical meaning.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not invent fasting times, medicine holds or test eligibility.

useCases.title: Find a value on an existing lab report
useCases.workflow: Selected report image -> OCR with page/bounding box -> copyable source-linked value
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician checks original and units.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No abnormality interpretation, diagnosis or mismatched-method trend comparison.

useCases.title: Record a suspected medicine problem accurately
useCases.workflow: Patient's experience -> exact transcript, uncertain names left uncertain -> callback/report record
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist or clinician assesses causality and urgency.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No adverse-reaction diagnosis or advice to stop therapy; urgent contact independent of AI.

useCases.title: Make a prescription clarification checklist
useCases.workflow: Extracted fields and ambiguous spans -> list prescriber questions -> clarification worksheet
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Pharmacist checks ambiguities and contacts prescriber.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Never complete missing strength, route, frequency or duration.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Make a caregiver shift handover
useCases.workflow: Approved practical tasks and notes -> concise handover by owner -> reviewed shift summary
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Outgoing caregiver approves; nurse handles clinical uncertainty.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No clinical instructions beyond separately approved plan or unauthorized sharing.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Split practical tasks among willing helpers
useCases.workflow: Offered help and availability -> draft meals/travel/companionship rota -> helpers accept tasks
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Helpers accept assignments; patient approves participation.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No clinical staffing decisions or detailed diagnosis shared with helpers.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Request respite or practical relief
useCases.workflow: Needed support and time constraints -> structured request -> verified respite-service enquiry
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Caregiver approves request; coordinator checks suitability.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No availability promise or assessment that an unattended patient is safe.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Keep a caregiver needs journal
useCases.workflow: Optional reflection on workload -> summarize selected needs -> private journal or chosen support request
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Caregiver controls sharing; counselor reviews clinical concerns.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No mental-health diagnosis, risk inference or emotional manipulation.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Revisit nurse-taught caregiving material
useCases.workflow: Question about prior training -> retrieve approved teaching segment -> accessible replay and question button
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinical educator approves content; nurse checks skill with teach-back/show-me.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No generated coaching for injections, feeding tubes or wound procedures.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Arrange a counselor conversation
useCases.workflow: User requests emotional support -> capture language/availability preferences -> counselor appointment request
useCases.requiredHumanReview: User approves contact; counselor assesses needs.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No therapy replacement, diagnosis or automatic disclosure to relatives.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Draft a consented family update
useCases.workflow: Approved facts and selected recipients -> translated short update -> patient preview before sharing
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient and clinician verify clinical statements.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No diagnosis or prognosis disclosure outside approved scope.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Find bereavement support
useCases.workflow: Requested location and support preferences -> search vetted directory -> dated contact options
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Coordinator verifies directory; user chooses contact.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No grief diagnosis, unsolicited follow-up or labels of normal/abnormal grief.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Preserve personal stories and messages
useCases.workflow: Consented personal recording -> transcript and optional chapters -> patient-edited keepsake
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient approves edits, storage and recipients.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No voice cloning, invented memories or unapproved posthumous sharing.

useCases.category: Caregiver support, family coordination and dignity
useCases.title: Plan family travel for a care visit
useCases.workflow: Confirmed location, dates and accessibility -> organize verified travel/stay options -> practical checklist
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Family verifies details before purchase.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No booking/payment without specific authorization or implied medical transport capability.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Ask for a suitable palliative-care centre
useCases.workflow: Spoken location and service needs -> filter verified directory fields -> centre cards and MapLibre location
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Directory staff verifies facts; patient/clinician confirms clinical suitability.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No AI quality ranking, diagnosis-based eligibility or bed promise.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Hear a centre's real access instructions
useCases.workflow: Verified centre record -> read phone, hours and referral requirements -> accessible contact card
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Service owner confirms current access information.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Use verified dated metadata; never invent walk-in rules or hours.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Book an allowed follow-up slot by voice
useCases.workflow: Spoken preference and real availability -> permitted slot proposal -> confirmation and backend booking receipt
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; clinic system is final authority.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Server-side identity, permission and slot checks; generated text is not a booking.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Change or cancel a booked visit
useCases.workflow: Existing visit and change request -> check scheduling rules -> confirmation then audited update
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Authorized user confirms exact change.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No cancellation by predicted attendance or ambiguous speech; preserve booking on failure.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Understand a missed-visit barrier
useCases.workflow: Opt-in follow-up conversation -> record stated barrier and requested help -> staff action request
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Coordinator reviews; user confirms rebooking.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No blame, automatic discharge or noncompliance inference; honor opt-outs.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Arrange a home visit
useCases.workflow: Access needs, availability and existing referral -> scheduling checklist -> coordinator-confirmed visit
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Coordinator validates referral and staff capability.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automatic urgency or staffing-safety decision; no visit claim before acceptance.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Request accessible transport help
useCases.workflow: Stated mobility needs and appointment -> capture requirements -> reviewed transport enquiry
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Transport provider and care team confirm safe suitability.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not decide ordinary transport is medically safe or replace an ambulance.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Request prescribed equipment support
useCases.workflow: Clinician-approved equipment requirement -> delivery/loan constraints -> verified service request
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician confirms device; equipment team verifies specification/training.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No device selection, oxygen setting, substitute or payment commitment.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Prepare documents for a benefit enquiry
useCases.workflow: Current official checklist and selected document metadata -> missing-paperwork draft -> social-worker review list
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Social worker verifies scheme rules and details.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No eligibility, coverage or reimbursement guarantee; no automatic submission.

useCases.category: Appointments, home visits and service navigation
useCases.title: Close the loop on a referral
useCases.workflow: Real referral identifier and service status -> reconcile actual acknowledgements -> next-action status card
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Coordinator confirms receipt, appointment and outcome.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Sent message is not accepted referral or completed consultation.

useCases.title: Explain an oncology term from a curated glossary
useCases.workflow: Selected unfamiliar term -> retrieve approved definition and translation draft -> source-linked explanation
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Oncology educator and bilingual reviewer approve definitions.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Vocabulary only; no personalized stage, diagnosis or prognosis inference.

useCases.title: Prepare an oncology appointment question list
useCases.workflow: Priorities and uncertainties -> editable agenda -> questions for oncologist and palliative team
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient approves priorities; clinician answers.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not choose therapy or answer life-expectancy questions.

useCases.title: Preserve the clinician's stated treatment intent
useCases.workflow: Clinician explanation -> exact transcript -> doctor-reviewed intent note and recap
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Oncologist verifies and discusses meaning with patient.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Never infer cure, palliation or prognosis from regimen or stage.

useCases.title: Coordinate an approved treatment calendar
useCases.workflow: Actual visits and signed schedule -> organize dates unchanged -> confirmed calendar/travel reminders
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Oncology service verifies schedule and clinical changes.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No chemotherapy timing, delay or dose recommendation; source systems authoritative.

useCases.title: Localize approved radiotherapy preparation material
useCases.workflow: Centre-approved leaflet -> translated draft preserving details -> approved accessible handout
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Radiotherapy team and qualified language reviewer approve.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No site-specific restrictions generated from generic material.

useCases.title: Retrieve the team's approved aftercare contacts
useCases.workflow: Current oncology aftercare plan -> requested approved section/contact -> source-linked instructions
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Oncology team verifies plan and escalation route.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No toxicity grading, symptom triage or reassurance to delay; contact staff if source absent.

useCases.title: Prepare questions for a dietitian
useCases.workflow: Stated food difficulties/priorities -> faithful questions -> dietitian consultation agenda
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Patient confirms; dietitian assesses and advises.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No meal plan, supplement or fluid prescription.

useCases.title: Communicate rehabilitation priorities
useCases.workflow: Meaningful activity goals -> stated barriers -> therapist-reviewed goals agenda
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Therapist assesses capability and approves interventions.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No exercise prescription, fall-risk score or claim an activity is safe.

useCases.title: Search verified supportive-care study information
useCases.workflow: Selected topic/location -> filter approved trial-directory metadata -> study links and nurse questions
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Research clinician verifies study status and eligibility discussion.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automatic eligibility, enrollment recommendation or invented recruitment status.

useCases.title: Prepare age-appropriate family communication material
useCases.workflow: Team-approved scenario/content -> draft language adaptation -> professionally reviewed family material
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Pediatric clinician, counselor and guardian review.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No autonomous child companion or prognosis conversation; age/consent safeguards required.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Capture nonclinical intake by voice
useCases.workflow: Contact, preferred language and visit purpose -> administrative prefill -> patient-confirmed registration draft
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Registrar verifies identity; patient confirms fields.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No diagnosis coding or automatic patient merge; minimize data collection.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Route an inbound service call
useCases.workflow: Appointment/record/billing request -> allowed administrative queue -> human handoff or confirmed task
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Staff owns resolution; caller confirms consequential actions.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Clinical questions go to qualified staff; no triage or unstaffed emergency promise.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Keep the centre directory current
useCases.workflow: Official notices and confirmed calls -> changed service/contact draft -> editor-approved dated updates
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Editor verifies each change with centre.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No publishing unverified scraped claims; retain provenance and corrections.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Summarize service feedback themes
useCases.workflow: Consented de-identified feedback -> cluster administrative themes -> reviewed improvement backlog
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Quality team checks themes and examples.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No patient-level sentiment scores, clinical conclusions or invented impact metrics.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Turn a service complaint into a reviewable case
useCases.workflow: Voice complaint -> faithful stated events and requested resolution -> reviewed complaint record
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Complainant confirms; advocate investigates.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No negligence finding, legal conclusion or unapproved disclosure.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Prepare a pending-records request
useCases.workflow: Referral checklist and received metadata -> identify missing documents -> reviewed service request
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Coordinator confirms necessity and permission.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automatic record transfer or inference that missing paperwork means absent care.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Index scanned clinical archives
useCases.workflow: Legacy scans -> OCR and metadata -> access-controlled searchable archive
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Staff checks patient linkage and extraction; clinician verifies clinical use.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not destroy originals, infer history or train on records without separate authority.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Format a clinician-approved letter
useCases.workflow: Completed clinician content -> format and translate draft -> clinician-signed referral/support letter
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinician checks facts/signs; translator checks meaning.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No fabricated certificates, signatures, eligibility statements or diagnoses.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Check patient documents for accessibility problems
useCases.workflow: Approved leaflet text/layout -> flag jargon and density -> human editing checklist
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Clinical editor approves wording and retained detail.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Do not automatically delete warnings or claim measured comprehension from an AI score.

useCases.category: Provider operations, records and quality improvement
useCases.title: Draft a clinic stock request from staff dictation
useCases.workflow: Authorized item/quantity dictation -> catalog structure -> reviewed requisition
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Stores officer verifies quantities and procurement approval.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No autonomous controlled-drug purchase, substitution or spending; receipt needs actual records.

useCases.title: Practice a synthetic serious-illness conversation
useCases.workflow: Educator-written fictional scenario -> patient role-play -> transcript for supervisor feedback
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Qualified educator reviews scenario and feedback.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Synthetic training only; no patient details or certification claim.

useCases.title: Practice difficult medical pronunciations
useCases.workflow: Approved terminology and fictional utterances -> audio and transcript comparison -> educator-led practice
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Bilingual clinician/interpreter judges pronunciation and meaning.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No interpreter certification; include negation, numbers and uncertain speech.

useCases.title: Create source-based palliative microlearning
useCases.workflow: Locally approved curriculum/passages -> draft learning cards/audio scripts -> approved modules
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Palliative educator approves each claim.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No invented recommendations, unlicensed copying or automatic protocol changes.

useCases.title: Transcribe an approved qualitative study interview
useCases.workflow: Protocol-consented recording -> transcript in approved environment and reviewed de-identification -> analysis copy
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Researchers verify consent, de-identification and fidelity.
useCases.implementationBoundary: Institutional data approvals before upload; de-identification is not guaranteed by a prompt.

useCases.title: Administer a service-experience questionnaire aloud
useCases.workflow: Approved questionnaire/consent -> audio questions and verbatim answers -> confirmed dataset
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Researchers approve wording, language validation and protocol.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No changing validated questions, inducement or diagnostic conversion.

useCases.title: Prepare a clinical-guideline change briefing
useCases.workflow: Two actual guideline versions -> cited explicit differences -> committee-reviewed briefing
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Specialist committee verifies evidence and decides adoption.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No automatic practice recommendation or protocol replacement.

useCases.title: Extract a research paper's reported study fields
useCases.workflow: Selected full-text paper -> design/population/outcome extraction with locations -> reviewed evidence table
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Researcher verifies all fields and limitations.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No fabricated citations, pooled efficacy or treatment advice from unverified extraction.

useCases.title: Translate participant information for review
useCases.workflow: Approved participant-information sheet -> translation retaining risks/rights -> reviewer-approved version
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Ethics team and qualified translator approve; human obtains consent.
useCases.implementationBoundary: AI cannot obtain consent alone or alter protocol language without approval.

useCases.title: Organize community palliative-service needs
useCases.workflow: Consented de-identified access interviews -> classify stated barriers -> human-reviewed needs report
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Researchers check themes, sampling and privacy.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No small-group identity leakage, prevalence estimate or inferred clinical need from convenience data.

useCases.title: Build a synthetic clinical-language safety test set
useCases.user: Sahara engineering and clinical safety team
useCases.workflow: Clinician-authored fictional utterances/gold transcripts -> error evaluation -> stratified report and release gates
useCases.requiredHumanReview: Bilingual clinicians verify labels and safety-critical errors.
useCases.implementationBoundary: No patient data or generic word-error-rate-as-validation; test dialects, negation, drugs and numbers.
